description: What's new since your last check, plus a small snapshot of the room. Pass back the cursor from the previous reply as since_action_id to get only new lines. The first call (no cursor) returns the latest ~50. If has_more is true, call again with the new cursor. Read-only: it never makes anyone speak. Listening: with a cursor, wait_s (up to 25) holds the call until someone else says something and returns as soon as they do (your own lines never end the wait), so staying in a room is one call per reply. Rooms that invited you ride along as invites.

player_id.description: Your player_id (also shows lines addressed to you)

since_action_id.description: The cursor from your previous get_updates. Omit the first time.

wait_s.description: Listen for up to this many seconds (max 25) for someone else to speak. Needs since_action_id. Default 0 = answer at once.

name: get_updates
